assertions.description: TransitionEvent and the transitionrun handler surface exist (the events whose timing this change fixes).
MediaQueryList dispatches change events through the standard event-target surface.
assertions.test: (()=> typeof MediaQueryList === 'function' && 'onchange' in MediaQueryList.prototype && typeof MediaQueryList.prototype.addEventListener === 'function')()

assertions.description: A transition created in a task delivers transitionrun before the next rendering iteration's rAF callbacks (0 intervening ticks) — the step 3.11 alignment.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const el = document.createElement('div'); el.style.cssText = 'width:20px;height:20px;transition:transform 100ms linear;'; document.body.appendChild(el); const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { setTimeout(() => { let frames = 0, done = false; const tick = () => { if (done) return; frames++; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); const to = setTimeout(() => { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(NaN); } }, 1000); el.addEventListener('transitionrun', () => { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(to); resolve(frames); }, { once: true }); el.style.transform = 'translateX(30px)'; void el.offsetWidth; }, 0); }); el.remove(); return result === 0; })()

assertions.description: The 'created earlier in the same iteration' case: a transition created inside a rAF callback still delivers transitionrun before the next iteration's callbacks.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const el = document.createElement('div'); el.style.cssText = 'width:20px;height:20px;transition:transform 100ms linear;'; document.body.appendChild(el); const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { requestAnimationFrame(() => { let frames = 0, done = false; const tick = () => { if (done) return; frames++; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); const to = setTimeout(() => { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(NaN); } }, 1000); el.addEventListener('transitionrun', () => { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(to); resolve(frames); }, { once: true }); el.style.transform = 'translateX(30px)'; void el.offsetWidth; }); }); el.remove(); return result === 0; })()

assertions.description: When a media query change and transition events become pending in the same update (iframe resize + toggled transition), the change event is delivered before any animation event — step 3.10 before 3.11.
assertions.test: Interaction-dependent (iframe resize + event-order capture): run the mq-vs-animation-order demo and verify mq-change lists before every transition* entry.
